title: Evaluation and molecular docking study of two flavonoids from Oroxylum indicum (L.) Kurz and their semi-synthetic derivatives as histone deacetylase inhibitors.
authors: Somsakeesit, La-Or; Senawong, Thanaset; Senawong, Gulsiri; Kumboonma, Pakit; Samankul, Arunta; Namwan, Narissara; Yenjai, Chavi; Phaosiri, Chanokbhorn
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物作为组蛋白去乙酰化酶抑制剂，涉及小分子-蛋白对接，但对象为酶-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Chrysin (5,7-dihydroxyflavone, 6) and galangin 3-methyl ether (5,7-dihydroxy-3-methoxy flavone, 7) were obtained from the leaves of Oroxylum indicum (L.) Kurz in 4% and 6% yields, respectively. Both compounds could act as pan-histone deacetylase (HDAC) inhibitors. Structural modification of these lead compounds provided thirty-eight derivatives which were further tested as HDAC inhibitors. Compounds 6b, 6c, and 6q were the most potent derivatives with the IC(50) values of 97.29 +/- 0.63 muM, 91.71 +/- 0.27 muM, and 96.87 +/- 0.45 microM, respectively. Molecular docking study indicated the selectivity of these three compounds toward HDAC8 and the test against HDAC8 showed IC(50) values in the same micromolar range. All three compounds were further evaluated for the anti-proliferative activity against HeLa and A549 cell lines. Compound 6q exhibited the best activity against HeLa cell line with the IC(50) value of 13.91 +/- 0.34 muM. Moreover, 6q was able to increase the acetylation level of histone H3. These promising HDAC inhibitors deserve investigation as chemotherapeutic agents for treating cancer.
abstract_zh: 从木蝴蝶（Oroxylum indicum (L.) Kurz）叶片中分别以4%和6%的产率获得了白杨素（5,7-二羟基黄酮，6）和高良姜素3-甲醚（5,7-二羟基-3-甲氧基黄酮，7）。这两种化合物均可作为泛组蛋白去乙酰化酶（HDAC）抑制剂。对这些先导化合物进行结构修饰，得到了三十八种衍生物，并进一步测试了其作为HDAC抑制剂的活性。化合物6b、6c和6q是最有效的衍生物，其IC(50)值分别为97.29 ± 0.63 μM、91.71 ± 0.27 μM和96.87 ± 0.45 μM。分子对接研究表明，这三种化合物对HDAC8具有选择性，且针对HDAC8的测试显示其IC(50)值处于相同的微摩尔范围内。进一步评估了这三种化合物对HeLa和A549细胞系的抗增殖活性。化合物6q对HeLa细胞系表现出最佳活性，其IC(50)值为13.91 ± 0.34 μM。此外，6q能够提高组蛋白H3的乙酰化水平。这些有前景的HDAC抑制剂值得作为治疗癌症的化疗药物进行深入研究。
